d:
Chhathi maiya ki jay! jay chhathi maiya!
Chhath mahaparv ki pavan bela men prastut hain anuradha paudval ji ki surili aavaz men chhathi maiya ke prati samarpit bhaktimay chhath gita. in madhur giton ke madhyam se anubhav karen sury dev ki upasna, chhathi maiya ki mahima aur lok aastha se jure is pavitr parv ki anuthi paranpraon ko. shraddha, bhakti aur vishvas se bhare ye chhath git aapke ghar-aangan ko bhaktimay vatavran se sarabor kar denge.
Chhath Pooja Geet: Ghatwa Ke Aari Aari
Singer: Anuradha Paudwal
Music Director: Surinder Kohli
Lyrics: Traditional
Album: Chhath Mahima
